steps.name: Small Groups
steps.summary: Small groups with a guide who knows every student. No anonymous lecture halls.

steps.name: The Flip-Slot
steps.summary: Learn the core concept first, then spend the session solving problems with a guide right there. No getting stuck alone at home.

steps.name: Daily Practice Test
steps.summary: Every class ends with a practice test on what was just taught. Immediate retention before leaving the classroom.

steps.name: Doubt Clinic
steps.summary: Doubts are solved in a separate short session. No lingering confusion carried into the next week.

steps.name: Human Guidance
steps.summary: The guide asks questions instead of giving away answers, helping students build genuine reasoning.

baseline.name: Entrance baseline for children
baseline.description: A short diagnostic on reasoning, reading and arithmetic; it places learners, it never excludes.

feePolicy.heading: Transparent Fee Policy
feePolicy.statement: Fees are shared when you enquire.
feePolicy.detail: We do not publish fee estimates or take online payments on this site. When you enquire, the centre owner calls you personally to understand your goals and share full fee details.

rules.title: Hints before answers

rules.title: Confidence calibration

rules.title: The no-device quiz wins

rules.title: Aims to be needed less
